The word ईषत् 'a little' is compounded with a case-inflected word which does not end with a कृत् affix and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

In the sense of 'hard and difficult' or 'light and easy' the affix खल् is added to a verb when ईषद् and दुर् and सु are combined with it as उपपद-s.

Terms: खल्

The affixes कल्पप् (कल्प), देश्य and देशीयर् (देशीय) come after a nominal or verbal stem which connotes a slight incompleteness.

Terms: कल्पप् (कल्प), देश्य and देशीयर् (देशीय)

The word ईषत् when the first member of a compound may optionally preserve its original accent.

Terms: समास accent

का is the substitute of कु when the meaning is 'a small'.

Terms: Some Substitution

The सार्वधातुक affix से (the ending of the 2nd person Present and Imperative आत्मनेपदि) get the augment इट् after the root ईश - अदादिगणः (2nd Conjugation).

Terms: इट् augment
